description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Improve the quality and dependability of AI-driven software through structured testing and new feature development. Take promising experiments from prototype to maintained production code, collaborating with customers, researchers and domain specialists.
 What you'll do
 - Find where automated AI systems fall short, then design and run evaluations to make them more dependable and efficient.
 - Build new capabilities for AI systems, including tool integrations, context handling, memory and multi-step workflows.
 - Analyze logs and experiment results to locate bottlenecks and separate genuine gains from measurement noise.
 - Work with customers and subject-matter experts to understand needs, then ship and maintain fixes end to end, typically within about 3 months.
 - Convert successful experiments into clean, maintainable production software.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Solid background shipping and running live software in Python and a typed JavaScript language.
 - Practical exposure to LLM-powered systems, including how they are coordinated, observed and served at scale.
 - Comfort speaking directly with customers to clarify needs and deliver working technical answers.
 - Prior time at a demanding technology company or an AI startup.
 - A bachelor's-level technical degree in computer science, electrical engineering or a related field from a highly regarded school.
 - Clear communicator with good customer instincts and a knack for pinpointing the heart of vague technical problems.
 - Independent, driven and creative, with a sense of ownership and sound product instincts.
 Bonus points
 - Curiosity about or exposure to chip design, semiconductors or hardware-software systems.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 350,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Relocation support
 Location and work model
 - San Jose, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
